name: Apiiro Guardian
description: The Apiiro Guardian connector lets Claude securely access your Apiiro Application Security Posture Management (ASPM) platform. Powered by Apiiro's Risk Graph and Deep Code Analysis, it surfaces prioritized application and supply‑chain risks with code‑to‑runtime context, enriches AI‑assisted development with security requirements ("secure prompt"), and supports pre‑commit remediation so risks are caught and fixed before they reach production. Use it to investigate findings, track remediation, and embed security guardrails directly into your development workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Apiiro Guardian to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Apiiro Guardian to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.apiiro.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Apiiro Guardian MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apiiro Guardian provides these MCP tools: apiiro_get_diff_scan_result, apiiro_override_risk, apiiro_query, apiiro_query_cve_info, apiiro_query_dependency_info, apiiro_resolve_repository_key, apiiro_secure_prompt, apiiro_threat_model, and apiiro_trigger_diff_scan.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Apiiro Guardian?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Apiiro Guardian in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Apiiro Guardian MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apiiro Guardian requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Apiiro Guardian is developed by Apiiro. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
